title: Cloud Computing - Part 2
description: Cloud computing with AWS covering EC2, S3, IAM, RDS, VPC, security, DNS, deployment, monitoring, and backup strategies. This submodule covers: IAM, RDS, VPC fundamentals, Security groups.
learning_outcomes: Understand cloud computing concepts and service models
Provision and manage AWS EC2 instances
Use AWS S3 for object storage and CDN
